# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** seven years old  <sub>[v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P18](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0018)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Dora](../character/dora.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Davy is a handsome child with a round head covered in a crop of fuzzy, curly yellow ringlets. He has a single dimple in one cheek, which gives him a comical, lopsided look when he laughs.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)_

## Personality

Characterized by a mischievous nature and a lively curiosity, Davy is prone to disobedience, heedlessness, and making frightful faces. His inquisitive disposition often drives him to ask endless questions, though he possesses a thoroughly practical mind that lacks any imagination. In his endeavors, he can be overly zealous, working with energetic effort that sometimes outpaces his discretion. Despite these rebellious traits, he has a natural knack for winning love, is easily comforted by plum jam, and aspires to become a storekeeper so he can keep abundant candy and bananas.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 IX A Question of Color P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031), +8 more_

## History

Davy Keith lost his father as an infant and was raised without proper guidance until [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) brought him and his twin sister, [Dora](../character/dora.md), to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Displaying an unruly and mischievous nature, he quickly caused trouble by playing pranks, stealing jam, and locking [Dora](../character/dora.md) in a toolhouse. After his lies made [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) cry, Davy tearfully resolved to stop lying, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) committed to guiding him despite his misbehavior. Over time, Davy questioned [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on various topics such as prayer and heaven, accidentally ruined a batch of lemon pies meant for a guest, and contended with feelings of jealousy toward Anne's student [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). His permanent stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) was secured after [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) passed away, leaving a fund set aside for the twins' care. Although he continued to require redirection at the dinner table, Davy grew deeply attached to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), warmly expressing his affection for her when she tucked him into bed.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), +31 more_

## Quotes

> "I just did it for fun. Things have been so awful quiet here for so long that I thought it would be fun to give you folks a big scare. It was, too."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P43](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0043)

> “I never will, now that I know it’s bad,” asseverated Davy between sobs. “If you ever catch me telling a whopper again you can . . .” Davy groped mentally for a suitable penance . . . “you can skin me alive, Anne.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P56](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0056)

> “Why?” queried Davy, settling comfortably down and looking up with a tearstained, investigating face. “Why ain’t whopper as good as falsehood? I want to know. It’s just as big a word.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P58](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0058)

> “Then,” said Davy decidedly, “Marilla is bad, for she tells them. And she’s worse’n me, for I didn’t know it was wrong but she does.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P68](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0068)

> “But I tell you there is,” persisted Davy. “It was in that question Marilla taught me last Sunday. ‘Why should we love God?’ It says, ‘Because He makes preserves, and redeems us.’ Preserves is just a holy way of saying jam.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P27](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0027)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--davy-keith.md)

Davy is a friendly and affectionate boy toward [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), though his mischievous tendencies often test her patience. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) regularly steps in to fix his pranks—such as secretly removing a toad he hid in Marilla's bed—and guides him through moral dilemmas, like explaining the consequences of lying after he locked his sister away. Despite the trouble he causes through jam-stealing and misbehavior, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels a fond affection for him and provides him with gentle moral and spiritual guidance.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +17 more_

- Friend of — affectionate towards her  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)</sub>

### [Dora](../character/dora.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

[Dora](../character/dora.md) is Davy's twin sister who lives alongside him at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Davy frequently targets her with his unruly pranks, such as causing her to fall into a pigpen or locking her inside Mr. Harrison's toolhouse, sparking frantically organized searches. Her quiet perfection stands in stark contrast to his troublesome behavior.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +18 more_

- Sibling of — twin sister  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +6 more</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--marilla-cuthbert.md)

[Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) acts as Davy's guardian, bringing him to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and attempting to discipline his unruly nature. Davy frequently causes trouble for her by playing tricks like hiding a toad in her bed, making mischief, and engaging in jam-stealing, which leads [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to issue stern warnings and moral guidance. Despite his frequent misbehavior and questioning of her rules, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) maintains a fond affection for him.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +14 more_

- Serves under — guardian who disciplines and commands him  <sub>[v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P29](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0029)</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--paul-irving.md)

Davy harbors strong feelings of envy and hatred toward [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) due to the praise and attention [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) bestows upon him. Davy struggles with jealousy over Paul's close relationship with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), viewing him as a direct rival for her affection.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P2](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0002), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P23](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0023), +2 more_

- Rival of — hated and envied for Anne's praise  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033)</sub>
